title: Takarṭa s umussu
lede: Tamura ɣef wakud, tanekra n Hanibal, tirzigin tiɣezfanin akked tdukliwin: Qarṭaǧ d Agaraw Alemmas deg umussu.
error: Ur tezmir ara ad d-tali tkarṭa.
eras.0.d: Imezdaɣ n Tyr, ddawt n Elisa, sersen Qart-Ḥadasht ɣer tagna n Tunes.
eras.1.t: Qarṭaǧ tekka-d ɣer tazwara n umaḏal apunik
eras.1.d: Imagoniyen ssizdigen taɣawla n Qarṭaǧ: Sardinya, lɣerb n Sqilliya, Ibiza, iswaq n ttjara di Tafrikt d Ispanya.
eras.2.d: Send tamenɣut tamezwarut tapunikt, Qarṭaǧ tḥekkem ɣef Agaraw Alemmas n lɣerb. Ṛuma tura kan tedmeǧ tegzirt n Italya.
eras.3.d: Terna deg 241, Qarṭaǧ teǧǧa Sqilliya; Ṛuma teṭṭef Sardinya d Kursika deg 238. Hamilqar iṛuḥ ad yeṭṭef Ispanya.
eras.4.d: Ispanya armi ɣer Ibru, lmeɛdan-is n lfeṭṭa akked Qarṭaǧant sserfedayen tirzi n Hanibal.
eras.5.d: Qarṭaǧ teqqim ala s tamurt-is tafriqit; Ispanya tṛuḥ ɣer Ṛuma. Masinisa yessimɣuṛ tamurt-is ɣef leḥsab n Qarṭaǧ.
eras.6.d: Qarṭaǧ tettwahuda. Tamurt-is tuɣal d tamnaḏt taṛumit n Afrika — isem ara yilin, deffir-agi, i umaḏal meṛṛa.
hann.0.2: Ahuzi n temdint tamɛawant n Ṛuma: amennuɣ yettwabeccer.
hann.1.2: Tazwara deg tefsut s ugar n 90 000 n uɛeskri uḍar, 12 000 ɣef wuyis akked 37 n ilfan.
hann.2.2: Hanibal yezger talast i gesbedd umɣiwan n 226.
hann.3.2: Imenɣan ɣer tuddar; ṭṭhur n yiɛeskriyen qqimen di Ispanya.
hann.4.2: Ilfan zegren ɣef tɣawsiwin n wasif ɣummen s wakal.
hann.5.2: Mraw d xemsa n wussan deg udfel; 26 000 n yergazen awḍen ɣer Italya.
hann.6.2: Tamenɣut tameqqrant tamezwarut: tuffra n Magun.
hann.7.2: Aɛesskar n Flaminyus yettwaṭṭef ger agelmam d yidurar.
hann.8.2: Tuzzna snat n tɣelfin: axsaṛan ameqqran deg umezruy aṛumi.
hann.9.2: Tamdint tis snat n Italya tekcem ɣer idis n Hanibal.
hann.10.2: Tikli ɣer Ṛuma akken ad yesseḥbes aḥuzi n Kapu: « Hannibal ad portas ».
hann.11.2: Yettwanɛet ɣer Tafrikt seld mraw d xemsa n iseggasen di Italya.
hann.12.2: Arsi ɣer rrif n Susa n wass-agi.
hann.13.2: Axsaṛan zdat Sisibyu akked Masinisa. Tagara n umennuɣ.
voyText: Inagmaren akked imsebrayen n Qarṭaǧ zegren tabuɣezt n Gibraltar ɣer Agaraw Aṭlanti, ɣer ugafa akked wadda.
voy.0.t: Tirzi tamezwarut n users, seg Finisya, s Qubus.
voy.1.t: Akka i d-tbeyyen Tirzi i yettwasnasen i Hanun: sețțin ibabuṛen, asers n iswaq ɣef rrif n Agaraw Aṭlanti n Lmerruk, sakin tanadi armi ɣer tagna n Gine (abrid-agi yemmeslay-it medden).
voy.2.t: Rrif n Ispanya armi ɣer « tegzirin n Oestrymnides » (Breṭanya ?), ɣef ubrid n lqesdir.
allText: Seld Kannas, ṭṭhur n usammar n Italya akked Agaraw Alemmas tekka-d ɣer idis n Qarṭaǧ. Ṛuma, nettat, tessuɣal inumidiyen ɣer idis-is.
allies.0.1: Tamdint tis snat n Italya tekcem ɣer idis n Hanibal seld Kannas.
allies.2.1: Tebra Ṛuma; Arkimid iḥudd tamdint armi 212.
allies.3.1: Amɣiwan ger Hanibal d Filib wis xemsa, yettwaḥerzen sɣur Bulib.
allies.4.1: At Buy akked At Insubrs ssukkren ɣef Ṛuma, sseǧhaden aɛesskar n Hanibal.
allies.5.1: Agellid anumidi n lɣerb, amɛawan n Qarṭaǧ, aṛgaz n Sofonisba.
allies.6.1: Ameqqran anumidi n ccerq: yekka-d ɣer idis n Ṛuma, yifran deg Zama.
allies.8.1: Tamdint tagrikit, amɛawan aṣfi n Ṛuma, i tt-id-yaɛlamen s zzerb n Hanibal.
src: Tilisa iqerrben ɣef leḥsab n tezrawin n umezruy (timnaḏin n tiɣawla, mačči d tilisa n wass-agi). Agrudem n tkarṭa: Natural Earth. Imukan iqdimen: isental yettwassnen.
